name: Blueprint Custom Apparel
old_description: Exceptional printing quality with personalized service from real experts. Bulk orders for trade shows, businesses, and events.
about:
Blueprint Custom Apparel was established in 2019 in Derry, New Hampshire. The company operates from its New England base, providing custom-branded apparel and promotional products to a range of organizational clients.

The shop specializes in screen printing and embroidery, producing custom sweatshirts, jackets, hats, T-shirts, and a variety of branded accessories such as outerwear, workwear, and safety gear. Its services cover the full decoration process, from artwork preparation to final stitching or ink application, serving both small-run and bulk orders.

Blueprint works with small businesses, schools, U.S. government agencies, universities, enterprises, and startups, supplying apparel for trade shows, corporate events, and everyday uniform programs. The customer list reflects a focus on institutional and commercial buyers seeking consistent branding across multiple garment types.

The company emphasizes a direct, account-based approach: each client is assigned a dedicated sales representative to manage orders from quote through delivery. Blueprint also highlights its commitment to top-tier materials, craftsmanship, and repeatable quality, positioning its New England production as a mark of local excellence.
